entities.name: Drunau
entities.description: A small but influential port town on the coast of Nephalia, under clandestine vampire influence.

entities.name: Alrun River
entities.description: River that begins where Kessig's Ulvenwald meets Gavony's Moorlands and reaches the sea at Drunau.

entities.name: Runo Stromkirk
entities.description: Vampire lord of the Stromkirk bloodline whose ancestral manor lies near Drunau.

entities.name: Elder Vetters
entities.description: Mayor of Drunau, a human servant of Runo Stromkirk.

entities.name: Stromkirk
entities.description: Vampire bloodline that roams Drunau and holds influence in Nephalia.

entities.name: Stromkirk Keep
entities.description: Fortified stronghold on a cliff above Drunau, the Stromkirk military outpost.

entities.name: Stromkirk Manor
entities.description: Ancestral residence of Runo Stromkirk, deeper in the cliffs.

entities.name: The Fauchard
entities.description: A secretive order of human vampire hunters who often operate out of Drunau.

relations.note: Human mayor who turns a blind eye for the promise of immortality.
relations.quote: Drunau's mayor, Elder Vetters , is a human servant of Runo Stromkirk

relations.note: Hunt vampires; any exposed Fauchard are hunted in return.
relations.quote: any Fauchard exposed by the Stromkirk are relentlessly hunted in return.
Drunau is a port town in the province of Nephalia on Innistrad .
